mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases the discount rate for equity valuations, compressing future cash flow present values and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals labor market deterioration and potential economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are significantly positive (t-test p < 0.05) in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of instances over a 3-year rolling window (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive policy to combat inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during periods classified as monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS rises.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of total nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) indicates a robust labor market and strong economic growth, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for PAYEMS as a predictor of 5-day SPX returns is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 3.5% annualized signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank rate hikes and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are significantly positive (t-test p < 0.05) in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and quarterly GDP (GDPC1) indicate a contraction in the real economy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and GDPC1 fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of instances over a 3-year rolling window (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market downturn, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals reduced consumer confidence and weak economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during periods classified as housing market downturns when HOUST declines.
